entries.desc: Default generation still works when no extra developer fields are supplied or senior mode is absent.

entries.desc: Default generation never emits senior filenames or raw secret contents.

evidence.note: The default tier uses authorityTrustProfileFileNames("basic") and emits only the basic filenames unless senior is explicitly requested.

entries.desc: Legacy authority_trust.env and staging-client.env aliases still resolve to the same effective bundle contents.

evidence.note: The legacy staging-client.env sidecar still loads through authority_trust.env and resolves to the same customer API key path semantics.

entries.desc: New Lattice-prefixed files and legacy aliases can coexist without duplicate or conflicting reads.

evidence.note: The loader still accepts a customer API key path from authority_trust.env, so old automation can keep using the legacy sidecar path.

entries.desc: Existing automation sourcing only the legacy names continues to work after the rename.

evidence.note: The generator now emits the Lattice-prefixed filenames by default while the compatibility regression block proves the legacy staging-client.env path still works.

entries.desc: Explicit senior opt-in writes lattice_senior_authority_trust.env and lattice_senior_staging-client.env.

entries.desc: Leaving senior mode off keeps the basic bundle as the default output.

entries.desc: The senior path cannot become the silent default or require extra developer fields.

entries.desc: Docs show the default bundle, the senior opt-in variant, and the legacy alias path together.
